definitions.gloss: note; annotation; explanatory remark; added comment
definitions.explanation: A brief written explanation or comment added to a text, document, or map to clarify or supplement the main content.

examples.japanese: ⟦{地図|ちず}→地図：02914_chizu⟧⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧{注記|ちゅうき}⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{加|くわ}えた→加える：01941_kuwaeru⟧。
examples.english: I added annotations to the map.

examples.japanese: {注記|ちゅうき}⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{参照|さんしょう}→参照：11866_sanshou⟧⟦して→する：00392_suru⟧⟦ください→下さい：02899_kudasai⟧。
⟦{報告書|ほうこくしょ}→報告書：06744_houkokusho⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{末尾|まつび}→末尾：13065_matsubi⟧⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦{重要|じゅうよう}→重要：01575_juuyou⟧な{注記|ちゅうき}⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦{記載|きさい}→記載：14169_kisai⟧⟦されている→する：00392_suru⟧。
examples.english: Important notes are included at the end of the report.

notes:
Composed of ⟦{注|ちゅう}→注：03434_chuu⟧ (note, attention) + {記|き} (write, record). Used for supplementary information added to documents, maps, charts, and other written materials.

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- {注記|ちゅうき}⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{加|くわ}える→加える：01941_kuwaeru⟧ — to add notes/annotations
- {注記|ちゅうき}⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{付|つ}ける→付ける：00761_tsukeru⟧ — to attach annotations
- {注記|ちゅうき}⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{参照|さんしょう}→参照：11866_sanshou⟧⟦する→する：00392_suru⟧ — to refer to the notes
- {注記|ちゅうき}⟦{事項|じこう}→事項：11469_jikou⟧ — annotated items; noted matters

SIMILAR WORDS:
- ⟦{注釈|ちゅうしゃく}→注釈：09766_chuushaku⟧ — commentary, footnote (more detailed explanation, often scholarly)
- ⟦{備考|びこう}→備考：15693_bikou⟧ — remarks, notes (used in tables and forms)
- ⟦メモ→メモ：00274_memo⟧ — memo, note (informal; personal notes)
- ⟦{脚注|きゃくちゅう}→脚注：06423_kyakuchuu⟧ — footnote (specifically at the bottom of a page)
- ⟦{補足|ほそく}→補足：08386_hosoku⟧ — supplement, additional information
